name: treino-personalizado
description: Aplicativo local de treino, preparado para PWA e Android com Capacitor.

scripts.sync:android: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.open:android: npm run sync:android && npx cap open android
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync:android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.build:aab: npm run sync:android && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
